$comment: Single source of truth for product and subscription settings. Do NOT put real Stripe keys here. Override secrets via environment variables in your deploy target. The frontend reads only safe public values from this file.

product.tagline_en: AI signals turned into commercial opportunities, daily.
product.tagline_ar: إشارات الذكاء الاصطناعي مُحوَّلة إلى فرص تجارية، يوميًا.

subscription.$comment_mode: Production switch: 'coming_soon' = waitlist phase (no gating, no charge). 'live' = real subscription with paid gating. Flip when payment provider is fully validated.
subscription.coming_soon_body_ar: كل المحتوى متاح مجانًا الآن خلال مرحلة الإطلاق. انضم لقائمة الانتظار لتحصل على وصول مبكّر بسعر مؤسّسين عند تفعيل الاشتراك.
subscription.coming_soon_body_en: All content is free during launch. Join the waitlist for early access at a founder-tier price when subscription goes live.

moyasar.$comment: Saudi-friendly hosted checkout (mada, Apple Pay, Visa, MC). Real keys live in env vars on Vercel.

stripe.$comment: Stripe stubs kept for parity / future US/global tier. Switch payment_provider to 'stripe' to use them.

analytics.$comment: Public analytics opt-in. Set plausible_domain or posthog_key in your deploy environment to activate. Both are free at small scale.

legal.refund_policy_ar: يحق لك إلغاء الاشتراك في أي وقت من صفحة حسابك. الاسترجاع متاح خلال أول 7 أيام إذا لم تستفد من المحتوى المدفوع. للاسترجاع راسلنا على بريد الدعم.
legal.refund_policy_en: You may cancel anytime from your account page. Refunds are available within the first 7 days if you have not consumed the paid content. To request a refund, contact support.
